shared_elements: horizontal row of repeated arch/loop (H-shaped) motifs with round bosses along the upper edge
horizontal band of zigzag / chevron-triangle pattern dividing registers
registered composition with animal figures below the patterned band
animals shown in profile with rounded heads and open jaws/beaks
justification: Both surfaces carry the same distinctive scheme: an upper row of repeated arch/loop signs paired with round bosses, separated by a horizontal zigzag-chevron band from a lower field of schematic profile animals with rounded heads, all in flat low-relief outline. The main difference is that B's lower registers show a richer and clearer inventory (a striding predator, a long-beaked bird, a plant-like frond, small figures) while A's lower field is limited to a few round-headed creatures, but the register logic and motif vocabulary correspond closely.
